description_sq:

📞 Për më shumë informacion ose për ta parë nga afër, kontakto tani!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in the most sought-after area of ​​Dry Lake, next to the Radisson Hotel. Data on the property: • Total area: 93m². • Organization: 2 bedrooms, 1 living room with kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one of which has a window) and 2 balconies. • Unobstructed view of the lake • The building is in the first row with the lake and there are no mountains • New and quality construction • Natural light throughout the day 📞 For more information or to see it up close, contact now!
